  Casual Role

  About Us:  At RSL LifeCare, our Residential Care teams have the ability to make a big difference to the lives of veterans and seniors while they receive quality and compassionate care in our aged care homes. This is an opportunity for you to join a large social purpose organisation where you can have a huge positive impact and feel the personal and professional reward in return. At our core, RSL LifeCare provide care and services to veterans and seniors who live in our communities or who are receiving support at home. Our vision of creating proud communities living their best lives is at the heart of everything we do as we continue to build upon our legacy of supporting veterans and their families for more than 100 years.   About the role:  As a Recreation and Engagement Assistant at RSL LifeCare, every day you're empowered to make a meaningful difference to people's lives. Within our supportive work environment your skills and compassion are valued. You will have the opportunity to: 
 
 Support the goals of care for the residents in the service in partnership with each resident and/or their representative 
 Identify barriers that prevent consumers from participating in meaningful and enjoyable activities 
 Encourage the wellbeing and independence of residents by supporting them to engage in preferred activities and interests 
 Embody a person-centred approach, recognising and promoting the individual's unique goals and preferences 
 Participate in risk management and continuous quality improvement activities 
 Build strong and productive relationships with your team to deliver positive outcomes for residents 
 
  About you  
 
 A fantastic outlook on life with a fun personality! 
 Experience working in Lifestyle/Recreational Activities teams in Aged care/Disability/Community services  desirable  
 Cert IV in Leisure and Health and/ or relevant tertiary degree  preferable  
 A sound understanding of aged care and the principles guiding this sector 
 General computer skills 
 Australian work rights 
 
  ?It is a mandatory requirement for a team member working in the Aged Care sector to have a valid RSL LifeCare Police Check or a valid National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) check, or potentially both, to undertake the inherent requirements of the role.    Our commitment to diversity  We welcome and encourage applications from people across our diverse community, especially from Veterans, current serving ADF personnel, their families and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants. We believe everyone has the right to feel safe, respected, valued and heard regardless of their gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity or disability.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Respectfully - No Recruitment Agencies Please.

We draw on the talents of our people and collaborate with others who share our vision and values to continue the pioneering spirit of Mary Aikenhead and the Sisters of Charity. We are committed to providing compassionate and innovative care, enabling hope for those we serve.

We are actively sourcing an experienced Service Desk Analyst to join our Service Desk Teams within St Vincent's. Reporting to the Service Desk Team Leader in your area, you will deliver prompt and effective resolution through the provision of first level technical phone and ticket support related to computer systems, software and hardware. With a true passion for customer service, you will be committed in providing high quality technical support across all areas of the organisation.

This is a Permanent Full-Time position based from our Group Head Office in Sydney. Hybrid work model in this role is encouraged.

Key responsibilities of the role: 

Provide outstanding technical support to users - respond to incoming requests via phone and ticketing system in an efficient and effective manner

Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues, and guide users through resolution steps

Liaise with vendors to escalate tickets where required, research solutions, and regularly review and update knowledge base articles

Assist and advise users on appropriate action and educate or coach where necessary

Install software on user's device remotely and perform any basic administration tasks such as password resets, account creations etc.

Proactively track, manage, resolve and complete requests and incidents within agreed service levels and maintaining customer satisfaction

Manage tasks in service request queue, resolve or triage incidents and requests within appropriate timeframe

Create and administer various shared network resources, provide permissions to software, drives and accounts and other general administrative needs

Things that work for us:

Tertiary qualification with some experience in Information Technology or qualified by experience in this field

Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills and a keen eye for attention to detail

Strong technical proficiency in Windows operation systems, remote desktop services, networking, hardware, telecommunications, and internet service troubleshooting

Demonstrated knowledge of Microsoft Platform, O365 services, cloud systems and prior experience with remote management and ticket management tools

Knowledge or experience within the healthcare or similar large scale, complex environment

ITIL v4 Certification - desirable

Ability to deal with conflict resolution, as well as collaborate and support on multiple priorities simultaneously and seamlessly while maintaining attention to detail in a high pressure environment

Proven personal management skills; self-enforcing punctuality, attendance, presentation and administration in all aspects and duties of the role

Things that work for you: 

Ability to visibly see your impact on the business and its service

Competitive salary packaging options

Discounted private health insurance

Employee Assistance Program for staff and their families

Access to the Fitness Passport (FP)

Why become part of St Vincent's Health Australia? Because there is so much heart here. Everywhere you go. You'll see and feel it across St Vincent's. At St Vincent's we value inclusivity and diversity and acknowledge the important of creating a work environment that is welcome, safe, fair and impartial and invite people from all backgrounds to join our caring St Vincent's family - better and fairer care, always.

Location: Woodhill QLD 4285
Company: QLD TC SERVICES PTY LTD
Employment Type: Full-Time – Permanent

About the Business
QLD TC SERVICES PTY LTD is a Queensland-based company committed to delivering reliable, high-quality, and customer-focused services. We pride ourselves on maintaining professional standards, operational excellence, and building long-term relationships with our clients. Our team is dedicated to providing efficient business solutions while fostering a positive workplace culture and ensuring compliance with Australian workplace standards.

Role Summary
The Human Resource Adviser provides professional advice on human resource policies, workplace relations, and employment conditions. The role supports recruitment, performance management, and employee relations while ensuring compliance with Australian employment legislation.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Develop, implement, and review human resource policies and procedures to ensure compliance with current workplace legislation and organisational requirements.
•	Provide accurate and timely advice to management and employees on employment conditions, performance management, workplace relations, and HR best practices.
•	Coordinate end-to-end recruitment processes, including advertising, shortlisting, interviewing, onboarding, and workforce planning support.
•	Support the development and implementation of performance appraisal systems and employee development initiatives.
•	Advise management on remuneration structures, employee benefits, and workforce planning strategies aligned with business objectives.
•	Manage employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary procedures, and conflict resolution in accordance with company policy and legal requirements.
•	Maintain HR records and analyse workforce data to prepare reports that support strategic decision-making.
•	Assist with organisational change initiatives by providing guidance on change management, communication strategies, and employee engagement programs.

Qualifications and Experience
•	Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in a related field, or equivalent.
•	Minimum one year experience in a Human Resource Adviser or HR Generalist role.
•	Sound knowledge of Australian employment legislation and HR best practices.
•	Strong communication, analytical, and organisational skills.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV along with a brief cover letter outlining their suitability for the Human Resource Adviser position at QLD TC SERVICES PTY LTD.

Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
